lines.zh: 我在水中滑行，鳍贴着水流。
lines.en: I glide through the water, fins along the current.

lines.zh: 我的触须在水里拖出细线。
lines.en: My tendrils trail thin lines in the water.
I travel with the current to save strength.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底走，泥沙被扬起。
lines.en: I move along the bottom and silt rises.
I slide up onto the bank.
I move toward you, very steadily.

lines.zh: 水里那位在我后面跟着。
lines.en: The one in the water trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我把身体压得很低，像一层水。
lines.en: I keep my body low, like a layer of water.

lines.zh: 我上半身浮出水面，慢慢前进。
lines.en: I lift my upper body out of the water and advance.
I round the reef without slowing.
My skin never stops moving.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，水变得更浑。
lines.en: The water grows murkier where I pass.

lines.zh: 我顺着暗流走，你看不出来。
lines.en: I follow the undercurrents where you cannot see.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边散开一些碎片。
lines.en: I shed fragments as I go.

lines.zh: 我朝气味最浓的方向去。
lines.en: I head for the strongest smell.
I drag myself across the shallows.

lines.zh: 我浮在水里，只露出一点。
lines.en: I float with only a little showing.

lines.zh: 我的触须慢慢张开，又收拢。
lines.en: My tendrils spread slowly, then close.
I am listening to the sounds on land.

lines.zh: 我身上的水一层层往下滑。
lines.en: Water slides off me in layers.

lines.zh: 我在等，等猎物靠近水边。
lines.en: I am waiting for prey to come near the water.
My hide glistens in the light.
I prop my body up a little.
Nothing of what I think shows.
Rings spread across the water.
I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我的腮盖一开一合，很慢。
lines.en: My gill covers open and close, slowly.
The smells here are muddled.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里换了个姿势。
lines.en: I shift my posture in the shallows.
I am very patient.
I raise my head squarely toward you.
You stand at the water's edge; too close.

lines.zh: 我的触须朝你的方向偏。
lines.en: My tendrils angle toward you.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，因为我没有眼睑。
lines.en: I do not blink; I have no lids.

lines.zh: 你身上的热，我感觉得到。
lines.en: I feel the warmth of you.
I rise another inch.

lines.zh: 我的外壳在动，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My shell moves as if breathing.

lines.zh: 我让水漫到了你的脚边。
lines.en: I let the water reach your feet.
I spread the plates at my front.

lines.zh: 我不急，水流会帮你靠近。
lines.en: I am patient; the current will bring you nearer.
The blow slides me back a distance.
One plate has cracked.
I flinch and the water sound scatters.
Murkier water runs from the wound.
I give half a foot, then steady.
Murky water seeps from my plate seams.
That put me on alert.
I draw my body in.
The one in the water grows restless.
I watch you and do not retreat.
I do not even sniff what you hold.

lines.zh: 这么点血肉，不够我长一寸。
lines.en: That much flesh won't grow me an inch.

lines.zh: 你把食物举在水边，很危险。
lines.en: Holding food at the water's edge is unwise.

lines.zh: 我吃的东西，你未必想听。
lines.en: You may not want to hear what I eat.
I swung my body aside.
That scent does not draw me.
It is not that I need.

lines.zh: 你放下它，我也不会靠近。
lines.en: Lay it down and I still will not come.
That would rot in the water.
I do not want this one.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我只滑开一点。
lines.en: You hit me and I slide only slightly.
Half of my body is soft.

lines.zh: 我贴上去，水浸了你一片。
lines.en: I press in and soak a patch of you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我顺势绕到你侧面。
lines.en: I use the knock to slip to your flank.

lines.zh: 我的甲片被你撞得响了一下。
lines.en: My plates clack where you struck.
I draw back a little and press in again.
The one in the water moved as well.

lines.zh: 你推我，我反而黏得更紧。
lines.en: Push me and I cling tighter.

lines.zh: 我的触须缠了一下，很快松开。
lines.en: A tendril catches, then releases.

lines.zh: 这点力道，推不动我的甲。
lines.en: That force cannot move my plates.

lines.zh: 我们是同一个体分裂出来的。
lines.en: We bud off from one body.
We do not have such bonds.
I leave a string of eggs in the water.
Our number grows on its own.
It needs no other.
I am only for spreading.
That part is not mine.
Another small cluster buds off me.
There are already enough in the water.
I do not understand the question.

lines.zh: 我用一条触须把它勾住。
lines.en: I hook it with one tendril.
I drop it back into the water.

lines.zh: 这东西在我身上滑走了。
lines.en: It slips off me.
I press it down into the mud.
I hold it; it has no taste.
I push it up onto the bank.
This does not look edible.
I draw it under my plates.
It is dry enough to rasp my plates.
I let it go.

lines.zh: 我忽然不漂了，我朝你游。
lines.en: I stop drifting and swim at you.
I shove the water aside and it swells.
I have got you fastened.

lines.zh: 我身上的甲片全都张开。
lines.en: Every plate on me opens.
The one in the water starts moving too.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很低的声音。
lines.en: I give a very low sound.
I cut toward the water's edge.
I suddenly quicken.

lines.zh: 你躲不进水，我就在门口。
lines.en: You cannot reach the water; I am at the door.

lines.zh: 这一带的暗流都归我调。
lines.en: The currents here answer to me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，一直在水里。
lines.en: I follow you, always in the water.

lines.zh: 你往岸上退，我就往岸上跟。
lines.en: You retreat inland; I follow onto land.
I change angle and cut you off.

lines.zh: 我的触须在水面拖出痕迹。
lines.en: My tendrils drag lines across the surface.

lines.zh: 我游得不急，可一步也没歇。
lines.en: I swim unhurried, yet I never once rest.

lines.zh: 水里那位从另一边过来。
lines.en: The one in the water comes from the other side.

lines.zh: 我游近时，水面开始鼓动。
lines.en: As I close in, the surface heaves.
You have muddied the water; perfect.

lines.zh: 我一直在你的视线边缘。
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your vision.
A little further and it is my ground.
I ram you with every plate open.
A tendril wraps your leg.
I press you down with my weight.
That one came with water, and it is heavy.

lines.zh: 我的甲片划开你的胳膊。
lines.en: My plates open your arm.

lines.zh: 我的甲片合上，夹住不放。
lines.en: My plates close and clamp down.

lines.zh: 水里那位同时扑了上来。
lines.en: The one in the water lunged at the same time.

lines.zh: 我的触须卷住你脚踝往下拽。
lines.en: My tendrils coil your ankle and pull down.

lines.zh: 这一下，水里已经有我的味道。
lines.en: Already the water carries my taste.

lines.zh: 我退开，把位置让给另一个。
lines.en: I pull back and yield the spot to another.

lines.zh: 水面先鼓起一块，然后是我。
lines.en: The surface bulges first; then me.
I rise out of the undercurrent.

lines.zh: 我带着一群碎片上了岸。
lines.en: I come ashore with a cloud of fragments.
The water's edge has suddenly grown crowded.
I straighten, taller than expected.
I draw my tendrils in.
The water here is good.

lines.zh: 我又产下一小团，落在旁边。
lines.en: I bud another small cluster beside me.
The one in the water is waiting for me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢浮上来，你没有听见。
lines.en: I rise slowly, and you did not hear.

lines.zh: 火把我的湿皮蒸得发白，我往水里退。
lines.en: Fire steams my wet hide pale; I back toward the water.

lines.zh: 我砸在石头上，甲片翘起来。
lines.en: I hit the rock and a plate flips up.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝，我一时撑不住。
lines.en: Water forces into my seams and I falter.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，掉回水里。
lines.en: The blast flips me back into the water.

lines.zh: 一根尖物卡在我的甲缝。
lines.en: A sharp thing is lodged in my plate seam.

lines.zh: 一股力封住我的甲片，我挣不开。
lines.en: Something seals my plates and I cannot open.

lines.zh: 我饿得发软，触须都不想伸。
lines.en: Hunger softens me; I cannot be bothered to reach.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，水里的电流窜遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning falls and current runs through all of me.

lines.zh: 脚下没了水，我这身重量也没处借。
lines.en: The water is gone, and my weight has nothing to lean on.
